name: hcportal_mergeHashers
description: Merge accounts, step 2 (E12.F6.S2): moves every run row and payment row (and memberships, chat, photos, receipts, down downs, songs, products, promotions, track imports, organiser links) from the merge account to the kept one; combines rows where both have one (runs by EventId+DisplayName, kennels, chat badges); recalculates run counts and kennel credit; disables the merge account as hcapp_gdprDelete does (Removed, every device signed out with a new secret, push tokens cleared). Nothing is deleted except exact duplicates in down downs, promotion and newsflash-read maps and friend links. Logged to LOG.GeneralLog. Requires HC.PlatformAdmin with CanEditKennel = 1. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth, then the HC.PlatformAdmin gate. Both accounts are locked (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) and must still be live; the whole merge is one transaction. HC.HasherKennelMap.IsMember is still combined here but is DEPRECATED (2026-10-13): never read it.

parameters.name: keepHasherId
parameters.description: The account that survives. From hcportal_previewHasherMerge. Required: NULL, or the same id for both, returns 'Two different accounts are needed'.

parameters.name: mergeHasherId
parameters.description: The account whose rows move to the kept one and which is then disabled. From hcportal_previewHasherMerge. Required: NULL, or the same id for both, returns 'Two different accounts are needed'.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always returned. Success = 0 with ErrorMessage on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, 'Two different accounts are needed', 'One of the accounts no longer exists or was already merged — preview again' (after ROLLBACK), or from the CATCH block (ROLLBACK, HC.ErrorLog row, ERROR_MESSAGE()). Success = 1 after COMMIT, followed by rowset 1.

rowsets.name: Moved
rowsets.description: Success only: one row of counts from the merge (NULL where the step did not record a count).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap: combine paired run rows into the kept row (best attendance/RSVP/hare/track/notes), soft-remove the merge twins (removed = 1, attendance/RSVP/hare/track cleared), move every other live merge row (UserId = keep)
UPDATE HC.Payment UserId, HasherEventMapId (to the combined row) and PaymentProcessedBy_userId / ConfirmedBy_UserId / CancelledBy_UserId; HC.Receipt UserId and ReimbursedBy
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap: combine paired kennel rows (flags OR-ed, historical counts the larger, dates widened), soft-remove the merge twins, move the rest
UPDATE HC.EventMessage (UserId, PublicHasherId); combine / soft-remove / move HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts per thread

UPDATE HC.KennelPhotos, HC.DownDownHashers, HC.DownDowns, HC.Event (Organizer_HasherId, EventLastUpdatedBy), HC.Song, HC.SongSession, HC.Product, HC.Promotion, HC.HasherPromotionMap, HC.TrackImport, HC.HasherOwnEvent, HC.PortalNewsflash, HC.PortalNewsflashRead, HC.HasherFriendMap, EXT.OfficeForms_KennelImport (ReviewedBy)
DELETE exact duplicates only: HC.DownDownHashers, HC.HasherPromotionMap, HC.PortalNewsflashRead rows the kept account already has; HC.HasherFriendMap self-links and duplicate links
HC.PlatformAdmin: the merge account's row moves to the kept account when it has none, else is soft-removed
UPDATE HC.Hasher: kept account fills blank HashName/FirstName/LastName/Photo/HomeKennelId from the merge account; merge account Removed = 1, ResetCode reset
UPDATE HC.Device for every merge-account device: new DeviceSecret, SignedOutAt, FcmToken/ApnsToken NULL, removed = 1
UPDATE HC.KennelCredit for the merge account: removed = 1, currentBalance = 0
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser and HC6.nonApi_updateKennelCreditByUser for the kept account
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog (merge summary JSON in Data)
On error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog after the ROLLBACK

codeSmells.issue: PackTrack points in Table Storage keep the old id
codeSmells.detail: Live positions are keyed by userId in Azure Table Storage. A run tracked by the merge account and not yet archived (the nightly job) stays under the old id; runs already archived travel with their HasherEventMap row.

codeSmells.issue: Kennel-pair join assumes one kept row per kennel
codeSmells.detail: Lines 182-186 JOIN (not TOP 1) the kept account's HasherKennelMap rows; if the kept account has two rows for one kennel, the INSERT into @kennelPairs (PRIMARY KEY mergeRow) fails and the whole merge rolls back with a raw ERROR_MESSAGE.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
